fields.label: Name
fields.help: Renaming runs ALTER DATABASE ... RENAME TO.

fields.label: Connection limit
fields.help: CONNECTION LIMIT; -1 or empty for no limit.

fields.label: Allow connections
fields.help: ALLOW_CONNECTIONS: off refuses new connections to this database.

fields.label: Template
fields.help: TEMPLATE: the database to copy; template0 to choose a different encoding or locale.

fields.label: Template database
fields.help: IS_TEMPLATE; YugabyteDB does not change it after create.

fields.label: Colocation
fields.help: COLOCATION: small tables share one tablet. Read back only for the database you are connected to.

fields.label: Session defaults
fields.help: ALTER DATABASE ... SET: defaults for every session in this database. Removing a row runs RESET.

notes: Started from the CockroachDB database form (same field ids; YSQL adds connection limit, allow connections, template, locale, template flag and colocation); providers/yugabytedb/databases.py. CREATE and DROP DATABASE run outside a transaction. Colocation is read with yb_is_database_colocated(), which answers only for the connected database. Round trip verified live on YugabyteDB 2025.2.2.2 by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_roundtrip_yugabytedb.py (2026-10-30).
